relevance_note: This case report describes one identifiable girl with a clinical picture of SSADH deficiency ('proved affected by a succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase (SSADH) deficiency') and her two ALDH5A1 variants.
method_note: Read the paper, the schema and the rules; no other source used. The paper contains no tables at all, so nothing was transcribed by script and there are no stacked (' / ') cells and no per-patient source column; the only figure captions are Figure 1 (pathway) and Figure 2 (EEG), neither giving patient-level data. One in-scope person: the single patient of the case report, labelled 'patient' (rule 5); the narrative 'literature review' names no other individual, so there are no source_reference_in_review rows. Variant type was not derived from the HGVS strings (the paper states no class). Zygosity: the paper writes 'two variants' without saying heterozygous or compound heterozygous, so zygosity is 'not reported'. Inheritance and parental testing: nothing is said about the parents or their variants, so both are 'not reported'. Points of uncertainty: (1) the EEG is reported as showing 'exceedingly slow activities and a sharp theta rhythm', while the authors also call that pattern 'not clearly pathological'; I recorded the finding as observed (both in phenotypic_features and for the checklist item 'EEG abnormality (background slowing or epileptiform activity)') and kept the qualifier in severity_or_detail; (2) the 1.5T MRI at 22 months 'has been reported as normal' is recorded as excluded 'abnormal brain 1.5T magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)' following D-27, while the checklist item for T2 hyperintensity is observed from the later 3T study, a different examination at a different age - I did not treat the two as a contradiction inside the paper, but note them here; (3) age at diagnosis is not stated separately from the first observation at 10 years and 3 months, so age_at_diagnosis is 'not reported'; (4) no treatment is reported for this patient (vigabatrin is discussed only in general terms), so treatment_summary is 'not reported'; (5) the negative molecular studies for fragile X, Prader-Willi and Angelman syndromes are recorded as excluded phenotypic_features rows under D-27 (the abnormality each rules out is named in feature_text_as_stated, the paper's own words are kept in the span); if these are judged to be investigations rather than features they can be dropped without affecting the checklist. Two negative determinations carry no span because there is nothing in the paper to quote: cites_prior_report_of_same_patients = false (the paper never says any patient was published earlier) and is_proband = true for the only patient of the case report. Every span was checked against the paper text.
